Title: LSJ: Play Master Clan Cards while in Vamp in torpor?

Messages.Author: Alexander Racher
Messages.Body:
Hey LSJ!

Yesterday while we played a very nice V:TES round in our club in Vienna
a problem came up which caused heavy discussions among players and our
referees:

I wanted to play Storm Sewers (Master: Unique Location/Nosferatu; tap as
you declare an action, if this action gets blocked, resulting combat is
at close range) but my only Nosferatu was in torpor.
Can I play Master Cards which require a clan when these clan members are
in torpor?

Thanks
Xandl, for C*A*R*D Vienna, Austria

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Alexander Racher wrote:
> Yesterday while we played a very nice V:TES round in our club in Vienna
> a problem came up which caused heavy discussions among players and our
> referees:
>
> I wanted to play Storm Sewers (Master: Unique Location/Nosferatu; tap as
> you declare an action, if this action gets blocked, resulting combat is
> at close range) but my only Nosferatu was in torpor.
> Can I play Master Cards which require a clan when these clan members are
> in torpor?

No.

VtES Rulebook (section 3.2):

Clan symbols: Sometimes a card has a clan symbol. (See Appendix B
for a description of the clans and their symbols.) If it's a master
card, you may only [play] the card if you have a "ready" vampire of
that clan. (A ready vampire is one who is controlled and in your
active area.)

and (section 14):

A vampire in the torpor region is still considered controlled, but
is not ready.
